$comment-1: Pinned eval session settings (ADR-0049 element 5). Loaded with --settings. See session.py docstring 'Pinned settings' for the probe record behind every key here.
$comment-2: PRIMARY tool enforcement is the --tools allowlist on the command line, which is verifiable: the init event echoes the resulting tool set. This file is defence-in-depth plus the permission mode. Both are asserted from the init event by run_session(); a mismatch invalidates the trial.
$comment-2b: defaultMode below is the ONLY source of the permission mode — run_session deliberately does not also pass --permission-mode, because probing showed the flag masks a silently-discarded settings file. init.permissionMode is therefore a receipt that this file was honoured, deny list included.
$comment-3: Path-scoped containment is deliberately NOT expressed here. The fixture root is a fresh per-run directory, so no static rule can name it; directional containment is proven per-run by containment_selftest() instead, fail-closed, before any trial counts.
$comment-3b: enabledPlugins switches off the plugins the CLI ships built in (probed 2026-09-28, 2.1.280: a fresh config dir still loads telemetry@builtin, and agents-md@builtin in an authenticated session; 2026-10-05, 2.1.289 added cc-plugin-plugin-authoring@builtin). With all three false init.plugins is []; run_session still refuses any plugin, so a new built-in stops the run until it is added here.
